images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable, dominant protagonist, one decisive action: an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The fantasy quest champion performs a body stretched toward camera on a high-speed elevated rail platform during Clockwork time reversal, reaching past a collapsing stack of giant books. The ordinary wall opens onto outer space, revealing a bioluminescent ocean cave impossible behind it and a giant eye in the background. Falling books visibly reverse upward, then the entire disaster freezes one whisker from impact. The furious internet-meme glare and body stretched toward camera are explicit, with train vanishing lines, blue cave glow, giant eye, suspended books and extreme perspective as impact cues. Camera 27mm, rail-level viewpoint, close-wide distance, deep depth of field, cold platform LEDs and vivid ocean-blue backlight, realistic weight, paws, whiskers, safe foam books and harmless VFX, no text, no watermark, no UI, no captions, no famous artwork, no franchise design, no actor likeness, no readable title, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no plastic fur, no malformed anatomy, no duplicate cats or limbs.
